video_title: Will New York and KAT come to a contract agreement? 🤔 + New-look 76ers first practice | NBA on ESPN

quotes.speaker: Shams Charania
quotes.summary_phrase: Karl-Anthony Towns willing to take a discount on contract extension
quotes.excerpt: Karl-Anthony Towns has made it clear to the Knicks that he is willing to take a considerable discount
quotes.quote: This is a growing cloud around the New York Knicks. Karl-Anthony Towns has made it clear to the Knicks that he is willing to take a considerable discount on his contract extension coming up, just like his teammates have, like Mikal Bridges, OG Anunoby, as well as Jalen Brunson. But right now, the Knicks want him to take a substantial pay cut, what he believes to be an extreme discount on his deal. Sources tell me the Knicks are offering Towns a four-year, approximately $200 million contract extension. That is $76 million less than his max.

quotes.speaker: Ramona Shelburne
quotes.summary_phrase: Knicks need to resolve Karl-Anthony Towns contract before season starts
quotes.excerpt: I think they need to get this done before the season starts, because you are the defending champs.
quotes.quote: I think they need to get this done before the season starts, because you are the defending champs, but you are just the defending champs until the season starts and then it is up for grabs. Once you start playing games, there is an injury risk, there is a performance risk if the Knicks are not as good as they were last season.

quotes.speaker: Marc J. Spears
quotes.summary_phrase: Karl-Anthony Towns holds leverage in contract negotiations with Knicks
quotes.excerpt: If he has the power next summer to be a free agent, just let it play out.
quotes.quote: If he has the power next summer to be a free agent, just let it play out. He is saying the right things, but in the essence, he has all the power in the end too. You still run the risk if you go to free agency, he stays and nobody else seems to want him. He has first-world problems. He has a $61 million player option for next season.

quotes.speaker: Ramona Shelburne
quotes.summary_phrase: Karl-Anthony Towns sacrificed his role for the Knicks last season
quotes.excerpt: Karl-Anthony Towns has shown a willingness to sacrifice his role in the past.
quotes.quote: Karl-Anthony Towns has shown a willingness to sacrifice his role in the past. All of last year, they did not run plays for him. He was a garbage man out there for most of the last year. Then in the playoffs, all of a sudden they needed him and they were going to run the offense through him. Mike Brown said, we have to run it through him and he did that. Defensively against Victor Wembanyama, we do not talk about that as much. I think that is when you are like, where is my reward for this?

quotes.summary_phrase: Challenges of integrating five alpha players on the 76ers

text_blocks.speaker: Marc J. Spears
text_blocks.text: The great Nolan Richardson once told me he only took three McDonald's All-Americans a year because he needed people to do other things. They got five alphas. How do they figure it out? Somebody is going to have to take less shots, somebody is going to get eight points, somebody is going to get 12 points. Are they going to be okay when they have non-All-Star numbers in the guise of we want to win a championship?

text_blocks.speaker: Ramona Shelburne
text_blocks.text: Everybody is trying to kind of earn LeBron James's approval and respect. I think there is an interesting quality to this now in Philly.

quotes.speaker: Dave McMenamin
quotes.summary_phrase: Jaylen Brown focusing on leadership and learning 76ers terminology
quotes.excerpt: He is just trying to do everything he can to have this be an opportunity and not
quotes.quote: He is just trying to do everything he can to have this be an opportunity and not an expectation. He told us about, I am doing the little things like asking questions, even if it may seem obvious, so I can learn the terminology so then I can be a leader with what we are trying to do. He said sometimes the play calls are the exact same play call that they were running in Boston for the last 10 years, but a word could mean something different in Celtic terminology than it does in 76er terminology.
